import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "experimental"
import "array"

getOrDefault = (f, d) => if exists f then f else d

// Aggregate request counts per group
data_request = from(bucket: "default_agg_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
      |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._field == "request_count" or r._field == "prompt_tokens" or r._field == "completion_tokens"  or r._field == "deployment_price" ) )
          |> schema.fieldsAsCols()


parent_deplyoment_data = data_request

  |> group(columns: ["parent_deployment"])
  |> keep(columns: ["parent_deployment"])
    |> distinct(column: "parent_deployment")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({

      deployment: r.parent_deployment
  }))


data_request_filtered = data_request
                        |> filter(fn: (r) => ((r.prompt_tokens != 0 or r.completion_tokens != 0)  and r.deployment_price == 0) )
data_request_result = join(
  tables: {data: data_request_filtered, deployment: parent_deplyoment_data},
  on: ["deployment"],

)
data_request_result
|> group(columns: ["_time"])
    |> sum(column: "request_count")
    |> group()

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "experimental"
import "array"

getOrDefault = (f, d) => if exists f then f else d

// Aggregate request counts per group
data_request_source = from(bucket: "default_agg_application")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  data_request = data_request_source
      |> filter(fn: (r) => ( r._field == "prompt_tokens" or r._field == "completion_tokens" or r._field == "api_request_count"  or r._field == "user_request_count" or r._field == "price" or r._field == "deployment_price" ) )

    |> schema.fieldsAsCols()

|> group(columns: ["deployment","model","parent_deployment","title"])
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
          user_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.user_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.user_request_count,
          api_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.api_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.api_request_count,
          prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,
          completion_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.completion_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.completion_tokens,
          price: getOrDefault(f: r.price, d: 0.0) + accumulator.price,
          deployment_price: getOrDefault(f: r.deployment_price, d: 0) + accumulator.deployment_price,

        }),
        identity: {api_request_count: 0, user_request_count: 0,  prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, price:0.0, deployment_price:0}
    )

// Determine the top model per title
top_models = data_request
|> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with parent_deployment: if exists r.parent_deployment and r.parent_deployment != "" then r.parent_deployment else "undefined" }))
  |> group(columns: ["parent_deployment"])
  |> top(n: 1, columns: ["user_request_count"])
  |> keep(columns: ["model","parent_deployment"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({

      model_top: r.model,
      deployment: r.parent_deployment
  }))


filtered_data = data_request
|> filter(fn: (r) => ((r.prompt_tokens != 0 or r.completion_tokens != 0)  and r.deployment_price == 0) )
  |> group(columns: ["deployment","title"])  // Grouping by column A
  
  |> reduce(
      identity: {user_request_count: 0,api_request_count: 0, prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, price:0.0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        api_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.api_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.api_request_count,
          user_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.user_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.user_request_count,
          prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,
          completion_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.completion_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.completion_tokens,
          price: getOrDefault(f: r.price, d: 0.0) + accumulator.price,
        
      })
      )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ 
      api_request_count: r.api_request_count,
      user_request_count: r.user_request_count,
     prompt_tokens: r.prompt_tokens,
      completion_tokens: r.completion_tokens,
      price: r.price,
      deployment: r.deployment,
      title: r.title,
    }))


  users = data_request_source
        |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._field == "user_hash"  ))
    |> schema.fieldsAsCols()
   |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with 
                              title: if exists r.title and r.title != "" then r.title else "not available",
                              user_count: r._value,
                              deployment: if exists r.deployment and r.deployment != "" then r.deployment else "not available"}))
  |> group(columns: ["deployment","title"])
      |> distinct(column: "user_hash")
 |>count()
   |> group(columns: ["deployment","title"])


   result = join(
  tables: {data: filtered_data, top: top_models},
  on: ["deployment"]

)


result1 = join(
  tables: {data: result, users: users},
  on: ["deployment","title"]

)

|> group(columns: ["deployment","model_top","model"])
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
          prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,
          completion_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.completion_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.completion_tokens,
          price: getOrDefault(f: r.price, d: 0.0) + accumulator.price,
          api_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.api_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.api_request_count,
          user_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.user_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.user_request_count,
          _value: getOrDefault(f: r._value, d: 0) + accumulator._value,
        }),
        identity: {api_request_count: 0, user_request_count: 0, prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, price:0.0,_value:0}
    )
result1
|> group()

import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
import "experimental"
import "array"

getOrDefault = (f, d) => if exists f then f else d

// Aggregate request counts per group
data_request = from(bucket: "default_agg_application")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
|> filter(fn: (r) => (r._field == "prompt_tokens" or r._field == "completion_tokens" or r._field == "user_request_count"or r._field == "api_request_count" or r._field == "price" or r._field == "deployment_price"or r._field == "user_hash"  ) )
|> filter(fn: (r) => (r.parent_deployment != "undefined"  ) )

    |> schema.fieldsAsCols()


|> group(columns: ["deployment","parent_deployment","user_hash"])
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
          user_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.user_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.user_request_count,
          api_request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.api_request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.api_request_count,
          prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,
          completion_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.completion_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.completion_tokens,
          price: getOrDefault(f: r.price, d: 0.0) + accumulator.price,
          deployment_price: getOrDefault(f: r.deployment_price, d: 0) + accumulator.deployment_price
        }),
        identity: {user_request_count: 0,api_request_count: 0, prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, price:0.0, deployment_price:0}
    )

    |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with

      request_count : r.user_request_count + r.api_request_count
  }))
// Determine the top model per title
top_models = data_request

  |> group(columns: ["parent_deployment"])
  |> top(n: 1, columns: ["request_count"])
  |> keep(columns: ["parent_deployment","deployment"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ 

      model_top: r.deployment,
      parent_deployment: r.parent_deployment
  }))



result = join(
  tables: {data: data_request, top: top_models},
  on: ["parent_deployment"]
)
|> group(columns: ["parent_deployment","deployment","model_top"])
    |> reduce(
        fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
          request_count: getOrDefault(f: r.request_count, d: 0) + accumulator.request_count,
          prompt_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.prompt_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.prompt_tokens,
          completion_tokens: getOrDefault(f: r.completion_tokens, d: 0) + accumulator.completion_tokens,
          price: getOrDefault(f: r.price, d: 0.0) + accumulator.price
        }),
        identity: {request_count: 0, prompt_tokens: 0, completion_tokens: 0, price:0.0}
    )


result
|> group()
